exit 0
--- stdout
Append an audited reconciliation decision without changing task status or review quorum.
Requires a registered orchestrator with current LIZA_AGENT_GENERATION
authority and the reconcile-verdict capability. Use inherited agent authority;
do not copy registration credentials into an operator shell.
Refuted and superseded clear a conflicting hold with a reason. Accepted rejection
keeps the unchanged review boundary blocked. Escalated keeps the hold pending.
Unmatched evidence remains non-gating regardless of disposition.
Usage:
liza reconcile-verdict <task-id> <finding-id> <accepted|refuted|superseded|escalated> [flags]
Flags:
--agent-id string agent identifier (overrides LIZA_AGENT_ID env var; legacy env alias is also accepted)
-h, --help help for reconcile-verdict
--json output result as structured JSON
--reason string required justification, at most 4096 bytes
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
